outputs.source: Written by .github/readme/src/capture.cjs to .github/readme/outputs-light.png and outputs-dark.png, and byte-identical here.
outputs.origin: Screenshots of pages built in a temporary folder by render_answer.py (Part 1 of the source text), condition_lab.py and comparison.py (the bundled, explicitly fictional teaching examples), framed by .github/readme/src/outputs.html and taken by .github/readme/src/capture.cjs.
outputs.transformation: Each page is photographed in its own window (the reading page at twice the density) and scaled into its panel; the frame is captured at 1920 by 870 CSS pixels, one device pixel each; an origin note is embedded in each file.

socialCard.origin: Browser capture of this page's briefing strip and plan view in the day theme with route R2 selected; the download signs, the version number, the baseline date, the question dock and the legs readout are hidden. Taken by .github/readme/src/capture.cjs.
socialCard.transformation: Captured at 1200 by 630 CSS pixels, one device pixel each; an origin note is embedded in the file.

fonts.origin: Subsets of Noto Sans SC and Noto Serif SC cut by website/scripts/build_page_fonts.py.

drawings.origin: The plan view, profile view, hold, compass rose and wind rose are drawn by project.js from the route, module, part and research data published on the page.
